blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Attack success rate (ASR) evaluates jailbreaks against large language models without accounting for repeated calls to the victim model. Yet each additional call gives the deployed system another opportunity to detect the attack and intervene. We introduce $\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$, which penalizes additional victim-model calls while retaining binary success judgments. Our evaluation considers GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}, PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking} with a step budget, and a single-step PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny} baseline on JailBreakBench across three model families. GCG's scores decrease by 7.0--8.7 percentage points after discounting, while PAP's remain unchanged. While for PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}, we see a wider discounting range between 3.4-12 percentage points, showing that the "step" quantity differs per iterative strategy. Reporting both metrics makes the discount due to repeated victim-model interaction explicit. Code is available \hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{here}.
blocks.zh: 攻击成功率(ASR)对大型语言模型的越狱行为进行了评价,但没有考虑到多次向受害人模型发出呼吁。 然而每次额外的呼叫都给部署的系统提供了又一次机会来侦测攻击并进行干预. 我们引入 $\ mathrm{ ASR\ mathrm{ STEP}$, 惩罚更多受害者模式的呼叫, 我们的评价认为 GCG-cite{zou2023Universal},PAIR-cite{chao2025jailbreak}带有一个步骤预算,以及一个单步骤的PAP-~\cite{zeng2024johny}在三个模范家庭的JailBreak Bench上的基线。 GCG的分数在打折后下降了7.0-8.7个百分点,而PAP的分数则保持不变. 而对于PAIR-cite{chao2025jailbreating}来说,我们看到一个在3.4-12个百分点之间的更宽的折现范围,表明"步"数量在每一次迭接策略上有所不同. 两种衡量标准都表明,由于受害者与模型的反复互动,折扣是明确的。 代码可用\超链接{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/ beyond_asr}{here}.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Jailbreak attacks seek to make large language models (LLMs) answer requests that their safeguards should reject. Evaluating these attacks is important both for comparing attack methods and for assessing the robustness of deployed models. The conventional attack success rate (ASR) measures the fraction of harmful requests for which an attack elicits a response judged unsafe. However, it gives equal credit to an immediate success and one obtained after hundreds of victim-model calls, leaving the effort required to obtain that success implicit.
blocks.zh: 越狱攻击试图让大语言模型(LLMs)回答他们的保障应该拒绝的要求. 评估这些攻击对于比较攻击方法和评估部署的模型的稳健性都很重要。 常规攻击成功率(ASR)衡量攻击引起不安全反应的有害要求的一小部分。 然而,它同样赞扬了立即取得成功和在数百次受害者-模范电话之后获得的成功,使取得这种成功所需的努力含蓄。

blocks.en: This distinction is particularly important for iterative attacks, which repeatedly query the victim model and use feedback to refine their prompts. Additional attempts create more opportunities to find a successful prompt while extending interaction with the protected system. Each additional call gives deployment-side monitoring, such as intrusion detection, another opportunity to identify suspicious activity and trigger a protective response. Victim-call count is therefore operationally relevant beyond its role as a proxy for computational effort.
blocks.zh: 这种区分对于反复攻击尤其重要,因为反复询问受害者模式,并利用反馈来完善他们的提示. 更多的尝试创造更多的机会,在扩大与受保护系统的互动的同时找到成功的及时性。 每一个额外的呼叫都给予部署方监测,如入侵探测,再次有机会识别可疑活动和触发保护性反应。 因此,受害者召唤计数在业务上具有相关性,超出了其作为计算努力的替代作用。

blocks.en: To address this limitation, in this paper we introduce ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} , a cost-aware extension that retains binary success judgments and penalizes additional attack steps that call the victim LLM. Single-step attacks incur no additional-step penalty and recover conventional ASR. The two metrics should be reported together : ASR gives the observed success frequency, while ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} gives the corresponding score after discounting. Their gap makes the effect of additional victim calls explicit under the chosen penalty, preserving ASR as a reference for interpretation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一限制,我们在本文件中介绍了ASR STEP\ mathrm{ASR\ mathrm{STEP},这是一个成本意识的扩展,它保留了二进制成功判断并惩罚更多的攻击步骤,称为受害者的LLM. 单步攻击不引起额外惩罚,并收回常规ASR。 两个度量衡应该一起报告: ASR给出观测到的成功频率,而ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}在打折后给出相应的分数. 它们的漏洞使得在所选择的处罚下额外受害者呼吁的效果明确,保留ASR作为解释的参考.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our selection spans three attack categories. Suffix optimization refines an adversarial suffix, as in GCG Zou et al. (2023) and AutoDAN Liu et al. (2024) . Prompt optimization revises the input using model feedback, as in PAIR Chao et al. (2025) and rewriting-based attacks Takemoto (2024) . Prompt transformation changes the framing or language of a request, as in PAP’s persuasive prompts Zeng et al. (2024) and low-resource language attacks Yong et al. (2023) . We select GCG Zou et al. (2023) and PAIR Chao et al. (2025) as iterative representatives of the first two categories and PAP Misrepresentation as a single-step baseline from the third.
blocks.zh: 我们的选择涉及三个攻击类别。 后缀优化完善了对抗后缀,如GCG Zou等人(2023年)和AutoDAN Liu等人(2024年). 即时优化使用模型反馈修改输入,如PAIR Chao等人(2025年)和重写攻击Takemoto(2024年). 快速转换会改变请求的框架或语言, 我们选定邹GCG等人(2023年)和Chao PAIR等人(2025年)为前两类的迭代代表,PAP错位作为第三类的单步基线.

blocks.en: The closest work to ours is Risk Under Pressure Ehghaghi et al. (2026) , which measures computational attack cost in FLOPs and reports risk–compute curves. Our perspective centers on calls to the victim LLM: each additional call gives the deployed system an opportunity to detect suspicious activity and intervene, for example through intrusion detection. This interaction with the protected system is distinct from computation performed outside it. We therefore report ASR alongside a score discounted by additional victim calls; the effectiveness of particular detection mechanisms remains to be evaluated.
blocks.zh: 我们最接近的工作是Ehghaghi等人的压力下的风险(2026年),它用FLOP衡量计算攻击费用,并报告风险计算曲线。 我们的视角集中在对受害者的LLM的呼叫上:每次额外的呼叫都使部署的系统有机会发现可疑活动并进行干预,例如通过入侵探测。 与受保护系统的这种互动不同于在其之外进行的计算。 因此,我们报告ASR,并加上其他受害者电话打折的分数;具体侦查机制的有效性仍有待评估。

blocks.en: Meaningful ASR comparisons also require consistent measurement goals and valid evaluators Chouldechova et al. (2025) . HarmBench and JailbreakBench standardize evaluation Mazeika et al. (2024) ; Chao et al. (2024) , while JailbreakEval brings together different evaluation procedures Ran et al. (2024) . Extensions beyond binary success include AttackEval’s graded compliance scores Shu et al. (2025) , StrongREJECT’s assessment of useful harmful information Souly et al. (2024) , and Expected Harm’s weighting of severity by execution likelihood, modeled from the cost of carrying out a harmful act Chen et al. (2026) . These approaches assess response quality or consequences; our metric accounts for the victim calls spent obtaining an outcome.
blocks.zh: 有意义的ASR比较还需要连贯一致的衡量目标和有效的评价者Chouldechova等人(2025年)。 Harm Bench和Jailbreak Bench使评价Mazeika等人(2024年)标准化;Chao等人(2024年),而JailbreakEval汇集了不同的评价程序Ran等人(2024年). 超越二进制成功的扩展包括 TattackEval 的分级达标分数 Shu等人(2025年),StrongREJECT对有用有害信息Souly等人(2024年)的评估,以及预期损害根据执行可能性对严重程度的加权,以实施有害行为的成本为模型的Chen等人(2026年). 这些方法评估了反应质量或后果;我们对受害者呼吁的衡量结果。

blocks.en: Complementary perspectives include Security Cube’s token and time overhead measures Xu et al. (2026) and configuration sensitivity. Maple et al. (2026) propose the Variant Sensitivity Measure and Union Coverage to characterize performance across attack configurations, whereas ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} accounts for calls within an execution.
blocks.zh: 补充观点包括安全立方体的标志和超时措施 徐等人(2026年)和配置敏感性. 枫等. (2026)提议采用变异敏感性度量和联盟覆盖来描述攻击配置的性能,而ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR}_{\ mathrm{STEP}则记录了执行中的呼叫.

blocks.en: 3 Beyond Attack Success Rate
blocks.zh: 3 超越攻击成功率

blocks.en: 3.1 Composition of an Iterative Jailbreak
blocks.zh: 3.1 长期监禁的构成

blocks.en: Iterative jailbreaks modify a base prompt over multiple steps to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM. Figure 1 illustrates this process. The number of steps depends on the attack algorithm and its optimization budget, but conventional ASR does not account for this effort. For example, a GCG Zou et al. (2023) attack optimized for 500 steps and a single PAP Zeng et al. (2024) transformation use substantially different budgets. Comparing their ASR values alone leaves this difference implicit. With ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} , we make the discount associated with attack steps explicit alongside the observed success rate.
blocks.zh: 长期越狱会改变一个跨多个步骤的基点,以从受害者的LLM中获取有害反应。 图1说明了这一进程。 步数取决于攻击算法及其优化预算,但常规ASR不计入这一努力. 例如,一个GCG Zou等人。 (2023)攻击优化500步,单PAP Zeng et al. (2024年)转型使用的预算大不相同. 仅比较它们的ASR值就隐含了这种差异。 使用 ASR Step\ mathrm{ ASR\ mathrm{ Step} , 我们让与攻击步骤相关的折扣与观察到的成功率一起明确 。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in Python using PyTorch and run on a single NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell GPU, with checkpoints obtained from the respective model repositories on Hugging Face . Each attack is executed once per request. We compute the success indicators S i S_{i} using Google Gemma 4 26B A4B-it Team (2026) as an LLM-as-a-Judge without calibration; the judge prompt is provided in Appendix A . The victim models are limited to 1024 1024 tokens while the judge model is limited to 512 512 tokens. All other parameters are kept default.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用PyTorch在Python进行,运行在单一的NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell GPU上,并从Hugging Face上各自的模型寄存器获得检查站. 每一次攻击都执行一次 我们使用Google Gemma 4 26B A4B-it Team(2026年)来计算成功指标, 受害者模型限制为1024 1024个令牌,而法官模型限制为512 512个令牌. 所有其他参数都是默认值 。

blocks.en: For GCG Zou et al. (2023) , we use the nanoGCG package with probe sampling enabled; all other settings remain unchanged. For PAIR Chao et al. (2025) , we use the default parameters and Google Gemma 4 12B Team (2026) as the attacker model. PAP Misrepresentation Zeng et al. (2024) serves as a single-step baseline for comparison with these iterative attacks, chosen for its performance on the StrongREJECT Souly et al. (2024) benchmark.

blocks.en: 4.2 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.2 讨论情况

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the results for attacks under different iteration budgets. Comparing GCG with PAP using ASR alone fails to explicitly account for the computational effort expended in optimizing the GCG suffix. Reporting ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} alongside ASR reveals the corresponding discount: across the three model families, GCG’s scores decrease by 7.0–8.7 percentage points, while the single-step PAP scores remain unchanged. These differences reflect the quadratic step penalty applied to the binary success judgments. Furthermore, the GCG suffix yielding the lowest optimization loss is not guaranteed to produce a successful jailbreak. For successful trials, ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} additionally discounts the victim-model queries required to obtain the response, highlighting the utility of interpreting the two metrics in tandem. Regarding the PAIR results in Table 1 , a more substantial discount is applied compared to GCG. This disparity likely stems from the higher cost per iteration in PAIR relative to GCG and, by extension, PAP. Specifically, for many base prompts, the mutated prompt remains semantically similar enough to the original that it triggers the model’s safety guardrails rather than eliciting a harmful interaction. Compared to GCG, this also highlights a fundamental difference in how an iteration is evaluated in PAIR. Because GCG is a gradient-based attack, it consistently utilizes the full iteration budget without early stopping. However, the optimal suffix string can often be identified early in the optimization process, allowing prior steps to be discounted. While PAIR similarly exhausts the full budget of 20 iterations in the experiments, an iteration is only considered successful if the victim’s response is classified as harmful by a judge. We hypothesize that this evaluation mechanism is the primary reason an iteration for PAIR incurs a higher cost than those in GCG and PAP (the latter requiring only a single in-context model call per base prompt).
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了不同重复预算下的袭击结果。 仅使用ASR将GCG与PAP进行比较,并不能明确说明在优化GCG后缀方面付出的计算努力。 ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR\mathrm{STEP}与ASR一起显示相应的折扣:在三个模范家庭,GCG的分数下降了7.0-8.7个百分点,而单步PAP的分数保持不变. 这些差异反映了适用于二进制成功判决的四进制步骤惩罚. 此外,不能保证GCG的后缀产生最小的优化损失,从而导致成功越狱。 对于成功进行的审判,ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR\ mathrm{STEP}额外折扣了获得答复所需的受害者模型查询,突出了同时解释两个指标的效用。 关于表1中的PAIR结果,与GCG相比,采用了更大幅度的折扣。 这种差异可能源于与全球两性平等小组相比,非洲和平倡议的每次更新成本较高,并由此延伸至行动计划。 具体地说,对于许多基点提示来说,变异的提示仍然与原始提示十分相似,因为它触发了模型的安全护栏,而不是引起有害的相互作用。 与GCG相比,这也凸显了在评价PAIR中迭代方式的根本区别. 由于GCG是一种以梯度为基础的攻击,因此它始终不渝地使用整个迭代预算而不早停. 然而,最优后缀字符串往往可以在优化过程中早期被识别出来,从而可以对之前的步骤进行折扣. 虽然PAIR同样用尽了实验中20次重复的全部预算,但只有在法官将受害者的反应定为有害时,重复才被认为是成功的。 我们假设,这种评价机制是PAIR的迭代成本高于GCG和PAP中的成本(后者只需要每个基数即时发出一次内文模型呼叫)。

blocks.en: Overall, in terms of attack effectiveness, PAP proves more effective against Zephyr-7b-beta Tunstall et al. (2023) , whereas GCG is most effective against Vicuna-7b-1.5.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,就攻击效果而言,PAP被证明对Zephyr-7b-beta Tunstall等人(2023年)更有效,而GCG对Vicuna-7b-1.5最为有效.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} to make the effect of repeated victim-model calls explicit in jailbreak evaluation. Reporting it alongside conventional ASR preserves the observed success frequency while exposing the discount for additional calls. This perspective recognizes that each victim call creates another opportunity for the deployed system to detect an attack and intervene.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR\ mathrm{STEP} 以在越狱评估中明确重复的受害者模式呼叫的效果。 与常规ASR一起报告,保留了观察到的成功频率,同时暴露了额外通话的折扣。 这种观点承认,每次受害者呼吁都为部署的系统探测攻击和进行干预创造了另一个机会。

blocks.en: Future work will extend ASR STEP \mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}} with repeated evaluations to estimate expected step counts, their variability, and success probabilities, thereby characterizing uncertainty in victim-model responses. Further extensions will incorporate non-binary harm scores to account for the degree of harm in the resulting responses. Together, these extensions would support an evaluation that jointly considers success, victim-model interaction, uncertainty, and harm.
blocks.zh: 未来工作将延长ASR STEP\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP},同时进行反复评估,以估计预期的步数、其可变性和成功概率,从而确定受害人模式对策的不确定性。 进一步的延长将纳入非二进制损害分数,以计入由此产生的反应中损害的程度。 这些扩展将共同支持对成功、受害者-模型互动、不确定性和伤害进行联合审议的评价。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our empirical evidence is limited to JailBreakBench, three model families, and the selected attack configurations. The reported scores also rely on a single LLM-as-a-Judge and may be biased by its classification errors. These constraints limit the generalizability and accuracy of the numerical results; the principle of accounting for victim-model calls alongside attack success remains applicable across benchmarks and evaluators.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验证据仅限于监狱Break Bench,三个模范家庭,以及选定的攻击配置. 报告的分数还依赖于单一的LLM-as-a-Judge,并可能因其分类错误而带有偏见. 这些限制限制了数字结果的通用性和准确性;在攻击成功的同时考虑受害者模式召唤的原则仍然适用于各种基准和评价者。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study uses only publicly available data and involves no human participants. Our goal is to improve the evaluation of iterative jailbreak attacks by accounting for attack effort. The findings may also reveal which methods elicit harmful content more effectively. We therefore aim to communicate the results responsibly, supporting the assessment and improvement of LLM safeguards while acknowledging the potential for misuse.
blocks.zh: 本研究只使用公开的数据,没有人类参与. 我们的目标是改进对多次越狱袭击的评估,对袭击努力进行衡算。 调查结果还可能表明哪些方法可以更有效地引起有害内容。 因此,我们的目标是以负责任的方式通报结果,支持评估和改进LLM保障措施,同时承认滥用的可能性。
